items.difficulty_reason: Four-equivalence chain fully executed: (1)<=>(2) definitional, (1)<=>(3) via the named versality-matches lemma, (4)=>(1..3) via the named formally-smooth-on-deformation-categories lemma, and the converse (versal => open smooth neighbourhood) is a full construction: choose a surjective smooth y: V -> X, form the fibre product Z, pick a finite type point (named existence lemma), apply the base-change-versal lemma, take the open neighbourhood W and its open image U', and conclude smoothness of U' -> X from the definition of smooth morphisms of stacks; the final versal-ring statement is prorepresentability by definition.
